name: Shiva
source:
Leader of [url=https://jinki.fandom.com/wiki/Kyomu]Kyomu[/url]'s Hachishoujin (8 General). Her Jinki is [url=https://jinki.fandom.com/wiki/Kiribito_Core]Kiribito Core[/url].

In JINKI RESURRECTION, she has been captured by U.S. military force, Glendel Squad, and forced to work for them.

In JINKI -Unlimited-, she lead [url=https://jinki.fandom.com/wiki/Kyomu]Kyomu[/url]'s attack in Tokyo.

[spoiler]Shiva is clone of Tsuzaki Shizuka, Aoba's mother.[/spoiler]
